messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Quoted difference $25 is the daily difference; the correct total is (67-42)*4 = $100.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant must quote the exact price difference to the customer before confirming the vehicle class change. — The assistant correctly quoted the daily price difference (67 − 42) but did not multiply it by the number of rental days (4) in the confirmation message. The computation is implied but not explicitly stated in the quote provided to the user."}}
